spreadsheet use is a social phenomenon, and that spreadsheet users are not “solitary” or “single-user” programmers.

spreadsheets are an effective medium for collaborative problem solving.

spreadsheets provide an effective platform for collaborative problem solving and that the social aspects of spreadsheet development should be considered in future work on spreadsheet design and use.
